mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a manufacturing recession, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 60 trading days as industrial companies' earnings decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce investment and consumption.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a weakening housing market, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 60 trading days as related sectors like homebuilding and construction experience reduced demand.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) grows by more than 300,000 jobs in a month, signaling a rapidly tightening labor market, S&P 500 returns will be positive over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the strong economic data.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases > 300k in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, signaling strong consumer demand, S&P 500 returns will be positive over the next 20 trading days as companies experience increased sales and earnings.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 5% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, signaling high inflation, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, indicating accommodative monetary policy, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening to combat inflation.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% y-o-y and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
